name: nodal-analytics
description: Plan, verify, and challenge analytics with governed, multi-source context and interview-built ground truth.

interface.longDescription: Build human-owned analytics context through structured interviews, plan read-only data questions against approved definitions, verify SQL and results, and challenge disputed answers with an independent review.
defaultPrompt: Build a governed analytics context layer with me.
Plan and answer this analytics question using our approved context.
Verify this SQL and result against the approved plan.
